messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they fall on a weekend).  
For each entry I’ve included the holiday name, the date it falls on, the day of the week, and the full weekend that it creates.

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Dec 30–Jan 2** (observed Jan 2) |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18–20** |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 20–22** |
| 5 | Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (observed Jul 3) |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2–4** |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7–9** |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | **Nov 11–13** (observed Nov 13) |
| 9 | Christmas | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23–25** |

> **Notes**  
> * **Observances** – When a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada typically observes it on the following Monday (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Remembrance Day).  
> * **Provincial Variations** – Some provinces have additional holidays that can create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador). The table above lists only the federal holidays that affect the entire country.  
> * **Boxing Day** – Dec 26 (Tuesday) is a statutory holiday but does not create a long weekend on its own.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use the dates directly for scheduling. If you need province‑specific long weekends or any other details, let me know!
